key_idea: For each letter the answer needs max(count in a, count in b) copies; any order works.
sketch: Count the 26 letters in both words and print each letter max(ca, cb) times. O(|a|+|b|). Use fast I/O for 1e6-length lines. Any arrangement is accepted, so the token checker reports mismatches on samples 2 and 3; I validated the outputs myself by comparing letter multisets against the per-letter maxima.
